chapter: Early life and New York scene
title: Other New York clubs: George's Tavern, Vanguard, Cafe Society
summary: Wilber and the interviewer list clubs and groups from those years, including Teddy Wilson's Cafe Society band.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Any other places you remember hearing in those days around New York? I was there off and on all through those years too.
I don't remember all the places either anymore.

Well, there was George's Tavern in the village where Frankie Newton used to play and Al Casey, guitar player, played there. The village vanguard used to have nice groups like Art Hodes had a trio there with Max Kaminsky and Freddie Moore.
I remember, I think, Albert Nicholas and Zutti and others were there. Yeah. Lead Belly quite a while.

Yeah. Yeah. Well, I remember, I guess this was 1940 or 41, hearing the wonderful group that Teddy Wilson had at Cafe Society with Edmund Hall and Sid Catlett and Emmett Berry and Benny Morton, who I've been working with recently. Yeah, I remember that group too. Yeah.
And had a Cafe Uptown one too. They had two of them going.
